name: GCR (Groupement des Concessionnaires Renault)
note: Alpine Endurance Team partner for 2026 (club release 19/03/2026). Per the club's WEC partners page text, GCR is a professional association founded in 1945 that federates Renault's primary distribution network in France. An association of Renault dealers has no single owner; no ownership claim written. See the pull request for what this means for a future rating.
